summary: Donor card declined with 'authentication required' on every attempt from EU cards
resolution: 3DS challenge was skipped for EU cards after gateway upgrade; restored SCA flow.

summary: Embedded donation widget shows blank iframe on WordPress site
resolution: CSP frame-ancestors header was too strict for custom domains.

summary: Salesforce sync creating duplicate contacts for returning donors
resolution: Email matching was case sensitive; normalized before upsert.

summary: Year-end tax receipt PDF shows wrong total for donors with refunds
resolution: Refunded amounts were not subtracted in receipt aggregation.

summary: Organization payout delayed 5 days, balance shows pending
resolution: Bank account verification expired; prompted org to re-verify.

summary: Peer-to-peer fundraiser page goal meter not updating after donation
resolution: Cache on campaign totals was not invalidated by new donations.

summary: Admin cannot invite new team member, gets access denied
resolution: Seat limit check used the wrong plan tier.

summary: Webhook for donation.created not firing for recurring payments
resolution: Recurring charges emitted a different event type; added mapping.

summary: Thank you email not received by donors using Outlook
resolution: SPF record missing for new sending domain.

summary: Donor cannot cancel monthly donation from donor portal
resolution: Cancel button hidden on mobile due to CSS regression.

summary: Event tickets QR code not scanning at check-in
resolution: QR payload exceeded scanner size limit; shortened token.

summary: Users locked out after enabling 2FA, codes always invalid
resolution: Server clock drift on one auth node.

summary: Mailchimp audience not receiving new donors tags
resolution: Mailchimp API rate limit hit; added backoff.

summary: CSV export of donations times out for large organizations
resolution: Moved export to background job with emailed link.

summary: Refund issued in dashboard but donor never got the money back
resolution: Refund stuck in gateway pending state; retried via gateway API.

summary: Donation form currency shows USD symbol for GBP campaign
